description: Return the single UNSIGNED call that claims a MAMO Account's rewards. They go to the owner except MAMO, which stays in the Account to be restaked; each row's `paidTo` says where it lands. There is no `preview_claim_rewards` twin because there is nothing to size: the call moves whatever has accrued by the block it lands in, so the figures are current, not a quote. Owner-only; nothing is signed or broadcast here.

address.description: The wallet that owns the MAMO Account, 0x-prefixed, on Base.

name: prepare_claim_rewards
title: Build the call that claims MAMO Account rewards
